description: Naming patterns for artisan goods with multiple input variations. Based on game data from Objects.json preserve types.

Aged Roe.note: Uses 'Aged' prefix on the product name, then input as suffix

Dried Fruit.note: Game uses 'Dried' as preserve type name, not 'Dried Fruit'

Dried Mushrooms.note: Game uses 'Dried' as preserve type name (same as fruits)

Honey.note: Flavored by nearby flower: 'Poppy Honey', 'Fairy Rose Honey', etc.

Cheese.note: Both Milk and Large Milk produce the same 'Cheese' (no input name prefix)

Goat Cheese.note: Both Goat Milk and Large Goat Milk produce the same 'Goat Cheese' (no input name prefix)

notes: The 'pattern' field indicates whether the input name is a prefix or suffix
These patterns match the game's preserve type naming in Objects.json
